STEP 1 - Scene: A small starter-style salad: mixed lettuce leaves with roasted beet/root chunks, a sliced candy-striped (chioggia) beet round, and a dollop of white soft cheese (likely goat cheese or crème fraîche), plus diced roasted potato or squash pieces.

STEP 2 - Vessel: White square plate, roughly 22 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 x (11)^2 ≈ 380 cm^2 (square plate, roughly comparable).

- Mixed leafy greens (green and red-tinged lettuce leaves)
- Roasted beet chunks (dark red)
- Diced roasted root/potato or squash pieces (golden)
- Sliced chioggia beet round

- Small amount of nuts/crumble (possibly walnut or seed bits)

Total food coverage ≈ 46% of vessel.

- Root pieces: 14 g x 90 = 13 kcal

- Cheese: 22 g x 260 = 57 kcal (soft fresh goat cheese range)
- Nuts: 1 g x 600 = 6 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 106 g and ≈ 94 kcal. This is plausible for a small, lightly dressed starter salad with a modest cheese portion; no oil or dressing was clearly visible, so none is added.
